_about: Quests, WoW style. A quest is offered by its `giver` once every quest in `requires` is done, and handed in to its `turnIn` npc once every objective is met. Objectives: kill (an enemy type, counted from every one defeated), collect (an item carried; taken on hand-in unless `keep`), examine (a world point). `location` names a world.json location for the minimap. `offer`, `progress` and `complete` are what the giver says at each step.

quests.name: The Missing Delivery
quests.summary: Mara Venn's iron never reached the old watch post. Follow the Fallen Road and find out what became of it.
quests.offer: Iron's late, and the watch post won't answer its door. Nine bars of grave-iron with my mark on them went up that road. Find out what happened and I'll pay for it.
quests.progress: Any word of my iron? A cart doesn't vanish. Look it over properly if you find it. A carter keeps papers.
quests.complete: That's Hollin's hand, and my mark on the iron. Bells at Hallow Cut. I don't like that at all. Here, as promised. If you mean to look further, look north, into the Blackwood. That's where the carters turn off.
quests.turnInLog: You hand Mara the manifest. She reads it twice.

quests.name: Bells at Hallow Cut
quests.summary: Hollin's manifest warns of bells at Hallow Cut, the old burial ground east of the road. Look over the graves and put down whatever walks there.
quests.offer: Graves don't ring. I've buried enough folk to know. Something's walking at Hallow Cut, and big, by the tracks on the road. Go and look at the graves, and if whatever rings those bells can be put down, put it down.
quests.progress: Still ringing? Then it's still walking.
quests.complete: A brute in grave-chains, carrying a watchman's blade? Then the watch post didn't just stop answering. Someone emptied it. Take this. You've earned it.

objectives.label: Look over the graves at Hallow Cut

quests.name: The Hound Den
quests.summary: The carters turned north into the Blackwood, past a den of barrow hounds beside the track. Thin the pack and search the den for any sign of them.
quests.offer: The carters turned north into the Blackwood. They'd not have got far. There's a den of barrow hounds by the track, past the shrine at the forest edge. Thin the pack, and tell me if you see any sign of my carters.
quests.progress: The hounds hunt in threes. Don't let them get round you.
quests.complete: No carters, then. Only bones and a purse. I'd hoped otherwise. The track's safer for it, at least. Take these. You'll want them deeper in.

quests.name: The Seer in the Glade
quests.summary: Someone is calling the dead up out of the Blackwood. Hunters speak of a seer among the standing stones in the far glade, and of archers camped on the way. Go deep and end it.
quests.offer: Bells under the Cut, a brute in a watchman's gear, hounds fat on carters. Someone is calling the dead up out of the Blackwood. The hunters talk of a seer among the standing stones in the far glade, and archers camped on the way. Go deep, Warden. End it.
quests.progress: The glade is at the end of the track. You'll know the stones.
quests.complete: It's quieter. I felt it at the anvil before you came up the track. Here, the best shield I've made this year. Keep it between you and whatever comes next.

objectives.label: Find the standing stones in the glade
